LLY.title: Zealthy Expands Insurance Coordination for GLP-1 Weight-Loss Medications
LLY.summary: Zealthy announced an expansion of its insurance-coordination program to support eligible patients prescribed GLP-1 weight-loss medications like Wegovy, Zepbound, Ozempic, and Mounjaro. The enhanced program streamlines prior-authorization submissions, insurance verification, and coverage determinations while maintaining that insurance companies retain full authority over approval decisions and patient costs.

LLY.title: Zealthy Launches Enhanced Weight-Loss Care Platform With Integrated Zepbound Access and Insurance Support
LLY.summary: Zealthy announced the launch of its enhanced virtual weight-loss care platform that integrates telehealth services, insurance coordination, and prescription management for obesity treatment. The platform enables patients to complete online health assessments and connect with licensed providers who may prescribe Zepbound (tirzepatide), an FDA-approved GLP-1 medication. Zealthy's membership starts at $39 for the first month and $135 thereafter, with medication costs billed separately. With insurance, eligible patients may pay approximately $25 per month for Zepbound.

LLY.title: Positive FDA Feedback on Phase 3 Brings Entera Bio's Oral Osteoporosis Pill One Step Closer to Market
LLY.summary: Entera Bio received positive FDA feedback on its Phase 3 protocol for EB613, an oral osteoporosis tablet based on teriparatide. The FDA accepted the company's proposed single-study registrational strategy with approximately 750 postmenopausal women, using total hip bone mineral density at 12 months as the primary endpoint. Phase 3 is expected to initiate in late 2026 with topline results anticipated in H2 2028. The approval could represent the first oral anabolic osteoporosis treatment, addressing a market where injectable therapies have limited adoption despite high efficacy.

LLY.title: Oryn Therapeutics Advances Next Phase of Orynotide™ Macrocyclic Peptide Platform Development with Expanded Leadership Team and Board Anchored by Accomplished Life Sciences Industry Veterans, Company Builders and Drug Developers
LLY.summary: Oryn Therapeutics announced strategic leadership appointments including Guy Rosenthal as CEO and Paul Sekhri as executive chairman, alongside board expansion with investor Nina Kjellson. The company is advancing next-generation oral and injectable macrocyclic peptides for inflammatory and autoimmune diseases, with a new collaboration agreement with Lilly ExploR&D to accelerate development programs.

LLY.title: New Long-Term Data Shows Lebrikizumab Sustains Atopic Dermatitis Clearance With Less Frequent Dosing and Advances Findings from Dr. Philip Werschler of Spokane Dermatology Clinic
LLY.summary: Long-term data from the ADjoin trial demonstrates that lebrikizumab (Ebglyss), an injectable treatment for moderate to severe atopic dermatitis, maintains skin clearance for up to 2 years with less frequent monthly dosing instead of biweekly administration. Nearly 80% of patients on monthly dosing maintained clear or almost clear skin, with 76% achieving IGA scores of 0 or 1, while maintaining a consistent safety profile.

LLY.title: Sitryx Completes Enrollment in Phase 1b Trial of First-in-Class Oral PKM2 Modulator SYX-5219 in Atopic Dermatitis
LLY.summary: Sitryx Therapeutics announced completion of enrollment in its Phase 1b clinical trial of SYX-5219, a first-in-class oral PKM2 modulator for moderate to severe atopic dermatitis, ahead of schedule. The trial enrolled 50 patients across US and European sites and is expected to readout in Q4 2026. The milestone follows positive Phase 1a data showing safety and immunomodulation of type 2 inflammation.

The company now holds 38,144,480 B shares as treasury shares, representing 0.9% of share capital.

NVO.title: TheDoseReport Announces Which GLP-1 is Best? Semaglutide and Tirzepatide
NVO.summary: TheDoseReport.com published a comprehensive comparison of GLP-1 medications, analyzing semaglutide (Wegovy, Ozempic) and tirzepatide (Zepbound, Mounjaro) for weight management. The analysis highlights that tirzepatide demonstrates greater average weight loss (20.2%) compared to semaglutide (13.7%), though both are effective. The article emphasizes the importance of consulting healthcare professionals and considering individual factors including medical history, cost, side effects, and lifestyle support when choosing between these medications.

ONEQ.title: Risk Assets Rise Amid Fed Rate Cut Expectations; QuantRate Announces Free AI Quant Trading Bot
ONEQ.summary: As markets anticipate potential Federal Reserve rate cuts in the second half of 2026, risk assets including equities and cryptocurrencies have rallied. The product will be managed by Monarq Asset Management and allows Bitcoin holders to deposit BTC directly and earn returns without converting to traditional financial products, competing with similar offerings like BlackRock's BITA and Yieldmax's MSTY.

FTS.title: Muskrat Dam First Nation Energized by Wataynikaneyap Power
